evidence.locator: The release lists five pictures on one frame: Galaxy Cluster 'El Gordo' with Mass Map; with Mass Map and X-ray; 'El Gordo' (Hubble ACS/WFC); 'El Gordo' (Mass Map); 'El Gordo' (Chandra X-ray). The files carry no sky tags. Measured here: the Hubble layer against Gaia DR3 gives 0.05000 arcsec per pixel, north 50.62 degrees right of vertical, 16 of 16 stars in the frame at 0.17 arcsec rms.
